questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the pickup-window endpoint behaves for a client that retries or repeats its request? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client POSTs a tracking event to /v1/shipments/4/events for a shipment whose status is already "delivered". What happens?
choices: 201; the event is appended and the status is updated
409 Conflict; no event is appended and the shipment is unchanged
404 Not Found, because closed shipments are no longer addressable
422, because the status in the body is not a valid transition

questions.prompt: A client requests GET /v1/shipments?status=returned, a value that is not in ShipmentStatus. What does the API return?
choices: 400 Bad Request produced by the handler
422 from FastAPI request validation; the handler does not run
200 with all shipments, since the filter is ignored when unknown

questions.prompt: Two clients concurrently POST new shipments with the same reference "ACME-0042" and different bodies otherwise. What is the outcome?
choices: Both get 201 because the uniqueness check is racy
One gets 201 and the other gets 409, because the reference check and insert run under the same lock
Both get 409 because each sees the other
One gets 201 and the other gets 422 from the model constraints
